model: QFA3150/MO room humidity and temperature sensor (Modbus RTU)
applies_to: Siemens QFA3150/MO room relative humidity and temperature sensor, basic documentation edition a (2021-01).
summary: The QFA3150/MO is a wall-mounted room sensor for temperature and relative humidity with a Modbus RTU (RS-485) slave port. Readings and settings are 16-bit holding registers. The map covers the two measurements with their reliability flags, the temperature unit, the communication settings and the firmware version.

addressing.note: The source states that register numbers count from 1, so register 1 (temperature) is wire address 0.

source.title: QFA3150/MO Room relative humidity and temperature sensor Modbus RTU (RS-485) Basic Documentation
source.pages: p. 7 (configuration parameters), p. 8 (Modbus registers), pp. 9-11 (DIP switches)

notes: Default baud is Auto; default format 1-8-E-1; default address 1.
Registers 764-766 are read-only to the master while DIP2 switch 7 is ON.
Temperature is treated as signed because the published range goes below zero.

registers.name: Temperature value
registers.description: Signed, hundredths of a degree in the selected unit.

registers.name: SW version major/minor
registers.description: Major in high byte, minor in low byte.

integration.summary: With DIP2 switch 7 OFF the sensor answers at address 1, 8E1, auto baud; read holding registers 0-3 with function 03.
integration.enable: DIP2 switch 7 OFF = configure over Modbus (registers 764-766); ON = DIP switch configuration (DIP1 address, DIP2 baud/parity/stop).
quirks: Temperature follows the unit in register 401.
setup: Bus termination is set with a jumper.
gotchas: Invalid DIP address: new communication settings are not applied.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
